lines.zh: 我一步一步压过绯红菌，咔咔响。
lines.en: I trample the crimson fungus step by step, crack, crack.

lines.zh: 这片林子是我的，我走得慢些。
lines.en: This forest is mine, so I walk a little slower.

lines.zh: 獠牙低着，我沿树干蹭过去。
lines.en: Tusks low, I scrape along the trunk.

lines.zh: 我闻着地走，鼻子比眼好使。
lines.en: I walk by smell; my nose beats my eyes.

lines.zh: 桥面窄，我照样横着走。
lines.en: The bridge is narrow; I walk it broadside anyway.

lines.zh: 每走几步，我就停下来听。
lines.en: Every few steps, I stop and listen.

lines.zh: 我被自己的蹄声惹烦了。
lines.en: My own hoofbeats are irritating me.

lines.zh: 前面有股不对的味，我绕开。
lines.en: Something smells wrong ahead; I go around it.

lines.zh: 我从菌林里拱出一条路。
lines.en: I root a path through the fungus grove.

lines.zh: 一群疣猪兽走在一起，地都震。
lines.en: A herd of hoglins walks, and the ground shakes.

lines.zh: 我走得理直气壮。
lines.en: I walk as if this whole forest owes me the road.

lines.zh: 小崽子跟在后头，别踩到它。
lines.en: The little one trails behind; mind your feet.

lines.zh: 我站着嚼，嘴边全是菌渣。
lines.en: I stand chewing, fungus crumbs all around my mouth.

lines.zh: 鼻子喷气，把地上的灰吹起来。
lines.en: I snort and the ash lifts off the ground.

lines.zh: 我在等什么，自己也说不清。
lines.en: I am waiting for something I cannot name.

lines.zh: 耳朵扇了扇，赶走一只虫。
lines.en: My ear flicks, chasing off a bug.

lines.zh: 我蹭树干，把背上的痒解掉。
lines.en: I rub the trunk to scratch my back.

lines.zh: 林子红得刺眼，我看惯了。
lines.en: The forest glares red; I am used to it.

lines.zh: 我刨了刨地，没什么可刨的。
lines.en: I paw the ground, though there is nothing to paw.

lines.zh: 热气从脚底冒上来。
lines.en: Heat rises from beneath my feet.

lines.zh: 我打个大哈欠，牙全露出来。
lines.en: I yawn wide and show every tooth.

lines.zh: 安静让我不安，我哼两声。
lines.en: Quiet makes me uneasy, so I grunt twice.

lines.zh: 你身上有人味，还有铁味。
lines.en: You smell of person, and of iron.

lines.zh: 我抬眼看你，头都没抬多高。
lines.en: I look up at you without lifting my head much.

lines.zh: 你也敢站在我面前？
lines.en: You dare stand before me?

lines.zh: 我盯你的腿，那里最容易倒。
lines.en: I eye your legs; that is where you fall easiest.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西我不认识，也不想知道。
lines.en: I do not know what you hold, and I care not to.

lines.zh: 你后退了半步，很好。
lines.en: You took half a step back. Good.

lines.zh: 我歪头，獠牙跟着偏过去。
lines.en: I tilt my head and my tusks swing with it.

lines.zh: 你的眼睛在找退路。
lines.en: Your eyes are hunting for a way out.

lines.zh: 别对我笑，我不懂那个。
lines.en: Do not smile at me; I do not understand it.

lines.zh: 我哼了一声，算是回答。
lines.en: I grunt once, and that is my answer.

lines.zh: 这一下打在皮上，我哼都没哼。
lines.en: That one hit hide; I did not even grunt.

lines.zh: 我被打得偏了半步，又站正。
lines.en: The blow turned me half a step; I straightened.

lines.zh: 谁打的？我记住你的味了。
lines.en: Who hit me? I have your scent now.

lines.zh: 疼，但疼让我更想撞人。
lines.en: It hurts, and hurting makes me want to charge.

lines.zh: 我的獠牙磕了一下，牙还在。
lines.en: My tusk knocked; the tusk is still there.

lines.zh: 我甩头，把痛甩到脑后。
lines.en: I shake my head and throw the pain behind me.

lines.zh: 皮厚不等于不会疼。
lines.en: A thick hide does not mean no pain.

lines.zh: 我退开两步，只是要再冲一次。
lines.en: I back off two steps only to charge again.

lines.zh: 这一击没把我打趴下。
lines.en: That blow did not put me down.

lines.zh: 伤口在烧，和这片林子一样。
lines.en: The wound burns, same as this forest.

lines.zh: 绯红菌，拿来，快点。
lines.en: Crimson fungus. Give it here. Now.

lines.zh: 那朵红菌一出现，我就跟上了。
lines.en: The moment that red fungus appeared, I followed.

lines.zh: 你举着菌子走，我一路拱你。
lines.en: You walk with the fungus raised; I nudge you the whole way.

lines.zh: 我吃这个，别的别举。
lines.en: This is what I eat; raise nothing else.

lines.zh: 味太香了，我口水都下来了。
lines.en: The smell is so rich my mouth waters.

lines.zh: 我抢，不等你递。
lines.en: I snatch it; I do not wait to be handed it.

lines.zh: 你别晃，晃了我咬到手。
lines.en: Do not wave it; wave it and I bite the hand.

lines.zh: 诡异菌？拿走，那味我受不了。
lines.en: Warped fungus? Take it away; I cannot stand that smell.

lines.zh: 为了这一口，我能跟你走很远。
lines.en: For that mouthful I would follow you far.

lines.zh: 吃完了，还有吗？
lines.en: Done eating. Is there more?

lines.zh: 你挡路了，我用肩膀说话。
lines.en: You are in the way; my shoulder does the talking.

lines.zh: 我撞开你，没打算停。
lines.en: I shove you aside with no plan to stop.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，你飞出去半步。
lines.en: We collide, and you slide half a step.

lines.zh: 我这身板，撞树都不亏。
lines.en: A frame like mine loses nothing hitting a tree.

lines.zh: 别贴着我走，我脾气不好。
lines.en: Do not walk against me; my temper is poor.

lines.zh: 我用头顶你，这是提醒。
lines.en: I butt you with my head; that is a warning.

lines.zh: 门口就这点宽，我先过。
lines.en: The doorway is this narrow; I go first.

lines.zh: 你一碰我，我全身的毛都竖了。
lines.en: One touch and every bristle on me stands.

lines.zh: 让开，我不想为你拐弯。
lines.en: Move; I will not turn for you.

lines.zh: 这一撞只是撞，不是打。
lines.en: This is only a bump, not a blow.

lines.zh: 那头母猪兽的獠牙比我的短。
lines.en: That sow's tusks are shorter than mine.

lines.zh: 我绕着她走，把地上的菌踩平。
lines.en: I circle her, flattening the fungus underfoot.

lines.zh: 我们用鼻子互相顶了顶。
lines.en: We butted noses, one against the other.

lines.zh: 我把最好的红菌拱到她面前。
lines.en: I root the best crimson fungus over to her.

lines.zh: 她哼一声，我就懂了。
lines.en: She grunts once, and I understand.

lines.zh: 我们并排站着，谁都不叫。
lines.en: We stand side by side, neither of us calling.

lines.zh: 幼崽生下来就带獠牙。
lines.en: The young come out already tusked.

lines.zh: 她走开时，我跟了两步又停下。
lines.en: When she walked off, I followed two steps and stopped.

lines.zh: 这林子里，找个伴比找食难。
lines.en: In this forest, a companion is harder to find than food.

lines.zh: 我守着她，直到她不再看我。
lines.en: I kept watch until she stopped looking at me.

lines.zh: 我叼起一块生肉，甩了甩。
lines.en: I pick up a cut of raw meat and shake it.

lines.zh: 地上的菌，我用鼻子拱进嘴里。
lines.en: Fungus on the ground, I root it straight into my mouth.

lines.zh: 这块皮革不是我的，我也拖走。
lines.en: This hide is not mine, but I drag it off anyway.

lines.zh: 我咬住木棍，一路甩到窝里。
lines.en: I bite a stick and swing it all the way to the nest.

lines.zh: 东西掉了？那是我的了。
lines.en: You dropped it? Then it is mine.

lines.zh: 我嘴里塞满了，还想再塞。
lines.en: My mouth is full and I still want more.

lines.zh: 我叼着骨头走，谁也别抢。
lines.en: I carry the bone; no one takes it.

lines.zh: 这块菌太小，我不屑捡。
lines.en: This fungus is too small; I will not stoop for it.

lines.zh: 我用蹄子把东西扒到一边。
lines.en: I scrape things aside with a hoof.

lines.zh: 掉落物在地上，我踩过去。
lines.en: Things lie dropped on the ground; I walk over them.

lines.zh: 有人进来了，带着不属于这里的味。
lines.en: Someone entered, carrying a smell that does not belong.

lines.zh: 我鼻子一抽，就知道该冲谁。
lines.en: One sniff and I know who to charge.

lines.zh: 那身甲在红林里太亮了。
lines.en: That armor shines too bright in the red forest.

lines.zh: 你踩断了一根菌，我听见了。
lines.en: You snapped a fungus stem; I heard it.

lines.zh: 有猪灵的味道，它们又来猎我。
lines.en: Piglin scent; they come hunting me again.

lines.zh: 目标就在桥那头，正合适。
lines.en: The target is just across the bridge; convenient.

lines.zh: 我低下头，獠牙对准前方。
lines.en: I drop my head and level my tusks.

lines.zh: 你跑起来的样子，让我更想追。
lines.en: The way you run makes me want to chase more.

lines.zh: 我锁定一个人，就不会换。
lines.en: Once I lock onto someone, I do not switch.

lines.zh: 那边有动静，不是风。
lines.en: Something stirs over there, and it is not wind.

lines.zh: 你在树上？那我就撞树。
lines.en: Up a tree? Then I will hit the tree.

lines.zh: 我不喊，喊了你就跑了。
lines.en: I will not bellow; bellow and you run.

lines.zh: 一双眼睛在红雾里亮起来，是我的。
lines.en: A pair of eyes lights in the red haze; mine.

lines.zh: 这一片，生人免进。
lines.en: No strangers past this point.

lines.zh: 我压低身子，蹄子开始刨。
lines.en: I lower my body and my hooves start pawing.

lines.zh: 距离够了，再近就撞上。
lines.en: Close enough; one step more and we collide.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的胸口，护甲最薄的地方。
lines.en: I fix on your chest, the thinnest of your armor.

lines.zh: 呼吸变重，那是要冲了。
lines.en: My breath grows heavy; that means the charge.

lines.zh: 我一步一步逼近，不急着动。
lines.en: I close in step by step, in no hurry.

lines.zh: 你退到墙边，正好。
lines.en: You back against the wall; perfect.

lines.zh: 我的獠牙离你只差一臂。
lines.en: My tusks are an arm's length from you.

lines.zh: 红雾里我看不清，但闻得准。
lines.en: The red haze blurs my sight; my nose stays sure.

lines.zh: 后腿绷紧了，像一根弦。
lines.en: My hind legs draw tight as a bowstring.

lines.zh: 我哼着气，一下一下。
lines.en: I grunt out breath, one beat at a time.

lines.zh: 你举盾？我照样撞。
lines.en: A shield? I charge it all the same.

lines.zh: 我数着你的脚步，一、二。
lines.en: I count your steps, one, two.

lines.zh: 这一撞，我准备很久了。
lines.en: This charge has been a long time coming.

lines.zh: 别回头看我，看前面。
lines.en: Do not look back at me; look ahead.

lines.zh: 獠牙一挑，你整个人歪了。
lines.en: One toss of my tusks and you go sideways.

lines.zh: 我撞在你身上，像撞一堵薄墙。
lines.en: I hit you like a thin wall.

lines.zh: 这一下顶的是肚子。
lines.en: This one lands in the gut.

lines.zh: 我的头骨比你的盾硬。
lines.en: My skull is harder than your shield.

lines.zh: 你被挑起来，又落下去。
lines.en: You are tossed up, then down.

lines.zh: 我咬着不放，直到你挣开。
lines.en: I bite and hold until you tear free.

lines.zh: 獠牙擦过你的腿，皮开了。
lines.en: My tusk grazes your leg and the skin parts.

lines.zh: 别把手伸到我嘴边。
lines.en: Keep your hand from my mouth.

lines.zh: 我一甩头，把你甩到旁边。
lines.en: One shake of my head throws you aside.

lines.zh: 这一下是为了刚才那箭。
lines.en: This one is for that arrow.

lines.zh: 你退，我就跟，很简单。
lines.en: You back off, I follow. Simple.

lines.zh: 我撞完还站在原地。
lines.en: After the hit I am still standing right here.

lines.zh: 蹄子也踩，不只是牙。
lines.en: My hooves stomp too, not only my teeth.

lines.zh: 你身上破了口子，我更来劲了。
lines.en: You have a gash; that only fires me up.

lines.zh: 我在红雾里睁开眼。
lines.en: I opened my eyes in the red haze.

lines.zh: 第一口呼吸全是菌孢子的味。
lines.en: My first breath was all fungus spores.

lines.zh: 我落地时就把身边的人撞开了。
lines.en: I hit the ground and shoved whoever stood near.

lines.zh: 生在棚里还是桥上，我记不清。
lines.en: Whether I was born in the pen or on the bridge, I cannot recall.

lines.zh: 我生下来就带着獠牙。
lines.en: I came out with tusks already.

lines.zh: 林子红得像烧着，我不怕。
lines.en: The forest glows like fire; I am not afraid.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖身上的菌渣。
lines.en: I shook the fungus scraps off my hide.

lines.zh: 远处有猪灵在看我，我哼了一声。
lines.en: Piglins watched from afar; I grunted at them.

lines.zh: 我是这一窝里最壮的那只。
lines.en: I was the strongest of that litter.

lines.zh: 脚下是硬土，头顶是红树。
lines.en: Hard soil below, crimson trees above.

lines.zh: 我闻到森林，就知道该往哪走。
lines.en: I smelled the forest and knew which way to go.

lines.zh: 新的疣猪兽站起来了，林子更吵了。
lines.en: A new hoglin stands; the forest is louder now.

lines.zh: 火苗舔到我的背，毛都焦了。
lines.en: Flame licked my back and singed the bristles.

lines.zh: 我从桥上掉下去，砸在菌堆上。
lines.en: I fell off the bridge and crashed into the fungus.

lines.zh: 这水太凉，我的鼻子灌满了。
lines.en: This water is too cold; my snout is full of it.

lines.zh: 一声炸响，我被掀到树边。
lines.en: A blast threw me against a tree.

lines.zh: 一支弩箭钉在我肩上，扎得深。
lines.en: A crossbow bolt is stuck deep in my shoulder.

lines.zh: 有什么东西在我皮下面爬。
lines.en: Something is crawling beneath my hide.

lines.zh: 林子里没菌了，我刨了一天土。
lines.en: No fungus left; I rooted at the dirt all day.

lines.zh: 雷落下来，整片红林都亮了。
lines.en: Lightning fell and the whole red forest lit up.

lines.zh: 脚下没有东西，我一直在往下掉。
lines.en: There is nothing underfoot; I keep falling.
